title: Game analytics: how do you track what engages players?
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
I instructed Astra to design an analytics system so I could reward players for achievements, and understand what engages players, and how many people have tried the game. My numbers aren’t great but still fun to see how players engage (love that one player for example, build a stack of 22 rocks in the cairn building mini game)

  
Astra designed a system that I don’t think is optimal but has worked so far: analytics are stored in a volume as json files.. surprising choice but also very cost efficient because it means I don’t need a third party/or database. Long term would not scale since the json files will get very large. Postgres or some kind of analytics service would scale better if the game ever got big.

  
long term I’d love to create some kind of automated loop to feed this and player feedback into the future development efforts.

game is: [https://fjordfall.fly.dev/](https://fjordfall.fly.dev/)
